mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 AM, here is today's balanced dish. Expect partly cloudy skies and 79 degrees near Badger Prairie County Park, though keep in mind the air quality index is currently at a moderate 55.

The City of Verona is hosting an I Voted sticker design contest for students grades K through 12, with designs due by July 22 and public voting beginning July 28. Also, remember to check your mailboxes and keep the area around them clear to prevent damage from winter plowing.
There is plenty to do in Verona starting today with Yoga at Insight Wellness, followed by trivia tomorrow at Hop Haus and Wisconsin Brewing Company.
In our weekly look at local law enforcement, on July 13, officers arrested a driver for an O-W-I after they were found trying to dislodge a vehicle from a large rock.
You can cool down with today's flavor of the day, Snickers Swirl. Culver's is currently closed, but they open at 10:00 AM if you want to stop by.
